schema.description: One workout the Concept2 Logbook holds, shaped as an IEEE 1752 physical-activity-1.0 payload with the Logbook's other figures beside it in snake_case. The anam_concept2 importer sends each result, read from the Logbook API: the monitor's result as ErgData synced it, splits or intervals and every stroke included, or a result entered by hand on the web, which carries totals only. Values are the Logbook's own, apart from the start time and activity name, which the importer derives. A Garmin watch worn on the rower records the same row on the Garmin leaf, so a sum across the leaves counts that time twice. This is the Concept2 leaf of activity.exercise-session: Concept2's own payload shape, named for its vendor (card 192), so a reader asks about exercise across the leaves by the prefix activity.exercise-session. and knows which shape each fact has. Version 1 is activity.exercise-session v2 cut to the fields Concept2 writes, each with the same rules, and its facets came across in card 195's rename (renames/vendor-leaves.json), each the next version of itself with its payload unchanged. The shared core, id, activity_name, effective_time_frame and source, is the same on all four leaves of activity.exercise-session (internal/def/shared-core.json).

activity_name.description: The IEEE 1752 activity name, mapped by the importer from the result's type: rower to rowing.machine, bike to biking.stationary, water to rowing, and any other erg (skierg, dynamic, slides, paddle, snow, multierg) to other; erg_type keeps what the Logbook wrote.

average_cadence.description: Average stroke rate, as an IEEE 1752 cadence: the Logbook's stroke_rate.

value.description: The source's average stroke rate, as reported.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute: the Logbook's heart_rate.average, which the importer leaves out when it reads zero, the monitor's figure for no heart rate belt.

base_movement_quantity.description: The stroke count, as an IEEE 1752 movement count: the Logbook's stroke_count.

value.description: The source's stroke count, as reported.

distance.description: Distance rowed in metres: the Logbook's distance.

comments.description: Concept2's comments on the result, verbatim, as entered in the Logbook. Absent when empty.

drag_factor.description: The rower's drag setting, as reported: the Logbook's drag_factor.

duration.description: The session's net duration in seconds: the result's time, which the Logbook gives in tenths of a second and the importer writes in seconds, the same figure the interval's duration holds.

ending_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.ending, beats per minute at the end of the workout. Left out when it reads zero.

erg_type.description: Concept2's type, the erg the result was rowed on as the Logbook names it: rower, skierg, bike, dynamic, slides, paddle, water, snow or multierg.

effective_time_frame.description: When the session happened, as an IEEE 1752 time interval.

duration.description: The session's length in seconds: the result's time, the work time without the rest between intervals.

value.description: Seconds, a whole or decimal number.

start_date_time.description: The start, ISO 8601 with offset, to the second, derived by the importer: the result's date_utc (the monitor's end of workout) minus its time, a UTC instant written with Z, or, for a result entered on the web, which has no date_utc and a date at midnight, that date as Sydney midnight, and start_time_known says which. This is the fact time.

id.description: concept2:session: and the Logbook's result id.

kcal_burned.description: Energy burned in kcal: the Logbook's calories_total.

logbook_date.description: Concept2's date, verbatim: the monitor's end of workout as a local wall clock time, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", or the day with a midnight time for a result entered on the web.

logbook_source.description: Concept2's source, how the result reached the Logbook: "ErgData Android", "ErgData iOS", "Concept2 Utility" or "Web" for one entered by hand.

logbook_timezone.description: Concept2's timezone, the IANA zone logbook_date is in. Absent on a result entered on the web, where the Logbook holds none.

max_hr_bpm.description: Peak heart rate in beats per minute: the Logbook's heart_rate.max, which the importer leaves out when it reads zero, as the monitor writes it even on a result whose splits carry a maximum.

ranked.description: Concept2's ranked, whether the result counts in the Logbook's rankings.

rest_distance_m.description: Concept2's rest_distance, metres rowed during the rests of an interval workout. Interval workouts only.

rest_time_sec.description: Concept2's rest_time, the rest between the intervals of an interval workout in seconds, given by the Logbook in tenths of a second. Interval workouts only.

source.description: Which app the session came from: always "Concept2 Logbook", written by the importer.

splits.description: Per-split measures for the workout, in the Logbook's order: its splits, or its intervals for an interval workout, each with the rest that followed it.

items.description: One split, each measure a plain number.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate for the split, beats per minute: the Logbook's heart_rate.average.

avg_spm.description: Average stroke rate for the split, strokes per minute: the Logbook's stroke_rate.

distance_m.description: Distance for the split, metres: the Logbook's distance.

duration_sec.description: Duration of the split, seconds: the Logbook's time, given in tenths of a second, written in seconds.

ending_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.ending for the split, beats per minute at its end. Left out when it reads zero.

kcal.description: Calories for the split, kcal: the Logbook's calories_total.

max_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.max for the split, beats per minute. Left out when it reads zero.

min_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.min for the split, beats per minute. Left out when it reads zero.

position.description: The split's position in the workout, from 1, in the Logbook's order.

rest_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.rest, beats per minute at the end of the rest after an interval. Intervals only, left out when it reads zero.

rest_time_sec.description: Concept2's rest_time for an interval, the rest that followed it in seconds. Intervals only.

watt_minutes.description: Concept2's wattminutes_total for the split, work done in watt-minutes.

start_time_known.description: Whether the start is the monitor's: true for a Concept2 result ErgData synced, false for one entered on the web, whose start is the day it names at Sydney midnight.

stroke_series.description: Every stroke of the workout as the monitor recorded it, in order: Concept2's stroke data for the result, each figure converted by the importer from the Logbook's units. Only on results that carry stroke data.

items.description: One stroke, from the Logbook's t (tenths of a second), d (decimetres), p (tenths of a second per 500 m), spm and hr.

distance_m.description: Distance rowed so far at this stroke, metres: the Logbook's d, decimetres, divided by 10.

hr_bpm.description: Heart rate at this stroke, beats per minute: the Logbook's hr, left out when it reads zero.

pace_500m_sec.description: Pace at this stroke, seconds per 500 m: the Logbook's p, tenths of a second, divided by 10.

spm.description: Stroke rate at this stroke, strokes per minute: the Logbook's spm.

time_sec.description: Elapsed work time at this stroke, seconds: the Logbook's t, tenths of a second, divided by 10.

verified.description: Concept2's verified, whether the monitor sent the result (true) or a person entered it (false).

watt_minutes.description: Concept2's wattminutes_total, the work done in watt-minutes as the monitor computed it.

weight_class.description: Concept2's weight_class, the Logbook's weight class for the result: "H" (heavyweight) or "L" (lightweight).

workout_type.description: Concept2's workout_type, the monitor's workout mode as the Logbook names it, such as JustRow, FixedDistanceSplits, FixedTimeSplits, FixedDistanceInterval, FixedTimeInterval or VariableInterval, or unknown for a result entered on the web.
